\section[o rio]{o rio — a river}

\label{lesson:PT-C57-rio}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for a mountain, then the Portuguese for a forest.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: o rio}
\textbf{o rio} — \textquotedblleft{}a river\textquotedblright{}. Rio de Janeiro is \textquotedblleft{}the river of January\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

\end{itemize}

What does o rio mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A river\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
